last_result.headline: Q39 built the stage matrix from CODE DIFFS alone (no re-run) using the kernels Q38 pulled, and found the simulator base is a CONFOUND: retrieval=0.080 came from 54968060 vs 54922806, which differ in TWO stages. Against the pristine baseline (6.6735, from a code-identical replicate pair spreading 0.009), overlap = -0.031 and GR sigma = -0.1105. So 54922806 edge is GR sigma, NOT retrieval, and it does not go inert on novel wells -- breaking the tie structure that made our-account-first cost +0.000. Counterweight: Q36 shows that same multiplier helps only 42.1% of wells on truth. Prefix calibration and model-package are measured inert; overlap is not load-bearing; the learned-trajectory blend is the only unknown stage (<=0.047). No stage change clears the threshold, so no submission. Queued q53 (zero cost) to re-run the simulator with the corrected decomposition.
